senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; √אם; cmp. אמיטתא)twilight, evening, nightfall. Pesik. Vayhi p. 63ᵇ; Pesik. R. s. 17 מא׳ (ו)עד חצות from nightfall to midnight.

units: <cite ref="Megillah 3a:21">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>א׳ ביטלתם וכ׳</he> this evening you neglected the evening offering.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 40b:18">Snh. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ הרגו</he> last night he killed him.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60a:10">B. Mets. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>שמרים של א׳</he> dregs of last night (yesterday), opp. to <he>היום</he>; a. fr.
